observations: Photos 0 and 2 show a used longitudinal automatic transmission lying on the ground at a parts yard, with a transfer case bolted to its rear.
The transfer case has front and rear output flanges, rusty brackets, and chalk marks reading CA and PB.
Photo 1 shows the same transmission still bolted to a V-type petrol engine with a black plastic intake manifold and yellow dipstick handle.
A white label is stuck on the transmission tail and transfer case in photos 0 and 2, but it is covered by the GEARUP INC watermark and cannot be read.
No maker logo, part number, VIN tag or engine code is readable in any photo.
Casings are dirty and dusty with surface rust on mounts; no cracks are visible from these angles. Nothing is running.

identity.kind: used 4x4 automatic transmission with transfer case

claims.evidence: Photos 0 to 2 show a longitudinal automatic gearbox behind a V engine, consistent with the claim, but the label is unreadable under the watermark and no part number or tag is shown.
Photos 0 and 2 show a transfer case bolted to the gearbox with a front output flange.
Origin cannot be shown by photos of the part.

claims.claim: drive with low (mileage, text cut off)
claims.evidence: A loose gearbox has no odometer; mileage cannot be shown remotely.

risks.risk: Gearbox is not the Jeep Wrangler 3.6 unit claimed, so the fitment and price are wrong.
risks.proof: Clear close-up, without watermark, of the label and part number on the transmission and on the transfer case.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced until the tag is read

risks.risk: Gearbox slips, shifts hard or has a failed valve body or solenoid.
risks.proof: Clip of the gearbox in a running vehicle or on a test stand shifting through the gears, with sound.

risks.risk: Transfer case faulty or 4x4 does not engage.
risks.proof: Clip of the transfer case lever moved through 2H, 4H, N and 4L with the shafts turning.

risks.risk: Unclear whether the engine seen attached in photo 1 is included or only the gearbox.
risks.proof: Seller statement plus a photo of exactly what will be handed over, laid out separately.
risks.if_unproven: as gearbox and transfer case only

risks.risk: Cracked casing or broken mounts hidden underneath.
risks.proof: Photos of the underside and both sides of the gearbox and transfer case.

proof_requests: Close-up of the transmission label and part number, without watermark.
Close-up of the transfer case tag.
Clip of the gearbox shifting through gears on a running vehicle or test stand.
Confirm whether the engine attached in photo 1 is part of the sale.
Photos of the underside and both sides of the casing.
response.reason: The photos show a 4x4 automatic transmission with transfer case, but the make, model and part number that set the price cannot be read; the only label is hidden under the watermark. A clear photo of the tag is needed before even a worst case price is possible.
